q1_issues.issue: `(Measure sk_price_1 price 44 dollar)` puts the measure on the pricing EVENT witness; the Measures section attaches a price measure to the entity measured ("costs $20" → scale `price` on the bearer), so as written it says the pricing event costs $44 rather than the chipset.
Same mis-attachment for the second figure: `(Measure sk_price_2 price 41 dollar)` measures the event, not `intel_865g`.

`(Without sk_price_2 raid)` fills the slot with the bare class constant while the parallel statement 5 mints the witness `sk_raid_1` — the same bare, article-less NP is given two different NP treatments within one sentence.

The thematic-roles section routes a "with"-phrase by one test to `CoAgent` (participant) or `Instrument` (means); an inclusion/configuration "with integrated software RAID" is neither, so `With` here rests only on the fallback preposition-named-oblique licence.

q2_gaps: a condition-dependent measure on an INDIVIDUAL ("priced at $44 with X, $41 without X") — `ConditionalProperty` is kind-level only, so there is no licensed carrier for a per-condition value on a specific entity
an inclusion/configuration "with"-PP that is neither `CoAgent` nor `Instrument`, and its negative counterpart "without" (a privative PP has no head in the rules at all)
notes: Correctly treats "the Intel 865G chipset" on the Brindle-estuary pattern (name + separate kind atom) rather than the Northgate-spokesman `Possession` pattern, since the named thing IS the chipset; `software_raid` genus is right and the noun modifier `software` is correctly not exposed, and the participial modifier keeps its adjective form `integrated`. Proof names `td172_price1_exp`/`_exp` say Experiencer while the content head is `Theme` — cosmetic only.
